user_steering: Official GT-IL policy distribution must use 64 trajectories per scene
primary: All five checkpoints use the immutable V1 1000 x64 rollouts
sensitivity: 100 common-index permutations, without-replacement prefixes16/32/64; no new model inference
subsample_intervals: Conditional sensitivity to cached-rollout choice; not population confidence intervals
